name: Ajman Saray Resort

address.street: Sheikh Humaid Bin Rashid Al Nuaimi Street

insider_take: Where Arabian Gulf tranquility meets timeless Emirati elegance — Ajman Saray is the Gulf Coast's best-kept luxury secret.
whats_special: Nestled along a pristine private beach on the shores of the Arabian Gulf, Ajman Saray, A Luxury Collection Resort sits in the smallest yet most charming emirate in the UAE. Unlike its flashier neighbors Dubai and Abu Dhabi, Ajman offers an authentically unhurried pace — and this resort perfectly captures that spirit. The property features stunning Arabian-inspired architecture , lush gardens, multiple pools, and direct access to a gorgeous sandy beach. As part of Marriott's prestigious Luxury Collection , every detail reflects local culture and heritage, from the intricate interior motifs to the world-class dining experiences featuring fresh Gulf seafood.
pro_tip: Book a sea-facing room or suite for unobstructed Arabian Gulf sunrise views — they're absolutely breathtaking and worth every penny. Also, Ajman is one of the few emirates that offers a noticeably quieter beach experience compared to Dubai, so this is ideal for travelers seeking true relaxation without sacrificing luxury.
dont_miss: Just minutes away, explore the Ajman Museum , housed in an 18th-century fort, for a fascinating glimpse into Emirati history. The nearby Ajman Souq is perfect for discovering local spices, textiles, and handicrafts. Back at the resort, don't skip the Amara Spa — indulge in a traditional Arabian hammam ritual for the ultimate Gulf pampering experience.
pros: Stunning beachfront location with pristine private beach access
Luxurious spa and wellness facilities with traditional Arabian treatments
Multiple dining venues offering diverse international and local cuisine
Elegant rooms and suites with modern amenities and Arabian design elements
cons: Located in quieter Ajman, requiring travel to reach Dubai attractions
Premium pricing typical of luxury resort properties
